name: CMIP6 Earth system model surface air temperature projections
model_or_instrument: 22 CMIP6 ESMs (including CanESM5-CanOE, CNRM-CM6-1, CNRM-ESM2-1, UKESM1-0-LL, FGOALS-f3-L, etc.)
resolution: 64 x 128 horizontal grid (remapped to CanESM5-CanOE), annual (1850-2098)

scales.note: 22 CMIP6 models remapped to 64x128 grid (CanESM5-CanOE) at annual resolution from 1850 to 2098 (249 years across 3 SSP scenarios).
